title: Answer
description:
Apostle and High Priest are named in one Man. The commission of the one who is sent and the commission of the one who is appointed meet in the Son.

The servant was faithful in all God’s house, and he was a servant in it. The Son is faithful over that house as Son.

The builder has more honor than the house. God is the builder. The Son is over the house God builds.

We are that house if we hold fast. Remaining in God’s house was always conditional. The condition now is holding fast to the Son.
